script.text: Well Yugi, we knew one of us had to lose. But the good news is one of us got to win, too! Congratulations, man!
Here, take my Glory of the King's Hand card. Show it to Pegasus's flunkie Croquet, and he’ll give ya three million bucks in prize money.
No, Joey. You keep it. Your sister needs that money.
I didn’t enter this tournament to get rich, Joey. I'm just here to save my Grandpa and the Kaiba brothers.
Please use this money for Serenity’s operation.
When I lost the duel, I lost all hope for saving my sister. But now... Yugi, thank you! Now go and take down Pegasus!
